text:
ana (mktg): Dropped a v1 of the competitor-claims doc in Drive: https://drive.redwood/reports/comp-claims-v1. Need quick feedback — priority: 1) claims we can back with numbers, 2) friction points vs cloud and self-hosted vendors, 3) sales-ready rebuttals. Plan to lock by EOD Fri.

michael (product): Got it. High-level suggestion: lead with smart routing + predictable latency as the primary differentiator vs cloud endpoints. Also call out automatic fallback to compatible model variants when capacity spikes.

sam (eng): +1 on routing. For bullet claims we should surface continuous batching + prefix/KV cache wins — in our microbench we see 2-3x token cost reduction on typical chat workloads. Be careful about absolute latency numbers (they vary by seq len).

emily (sales): Sales needs a 1-slide objection playbook. Example: if prospect says "Cloud X has better throughput" -> quick script + proof points (reserved capacity + SLA + sample latency table). Can someone draft 3-4 rebuttals?

marco (research): Benchmark context (for doc): dataset = open-web-short (1k queries), workload = 1000 concurrent short reqs, hardware baseline = p4d vs our dedicated cluster snapshot. Measured: p50 120ms, p95 310ms, p99 720ms. Cost calc (approx): $22 / 1M tokens on our reserved config vs ~$28 / 1M on the cloud endpoint we tested. Caveats: different model variants, token distribution, and batchability. Recommend "range-based" claims rather than single-point numbers.

sam (eng): Draft claim snippets for the battlecard (feel free to edit):
```
- Latency: p95 <= 350ms on reserved configs (typical); p99 worst-case fallbacks up to ~800ms.
- Cost: typical unit savings 15-25% vs public cloud endpoints (workload dependent).
- Reliability: automatic fallback to quantized model variant keeps requests live during capacity spikes.
```

michael (product): Can we make the cost claim more defensible with a short calc example showing batching + KV hit assumptions? Emily needs that for enterprise decks. Also want a one-line differentiator vs infra vendors: "We give the control plane + SLA without DIY ops."

ana (typo correction) — note: ignore; (removed)

emily (sales): Ops — also need 30s soundbites vs specific vendors: Bedrock, Vertex, OpenAI hosted, and a generic "self-host vendor". Eg: "Predictable latency, cost controls, unified infra across hosted/dedicated/private." Can someone produce 3 lines each?

marco (research): I'll add a short "how we ran it" paragraph and include the raw CSV and config. Also adding the caveats list so legal/product can vet.

ops-bot: Benchmark run metadata: snapshot run-2026-03-18-12:40, logs: /bench/1852/run-1852004321, no regressions flagged.

michael (product): I'll draft the vendor-specific 30s soundbites and post here by EOD.

ana (mktg): Action items (I'll own compilation): 1) sam -> short cost calculation slide (due Thu AM), 2) marco -> benchmark caveats + raw exports (Thu AM), 3) emily -> 1-slide objection playbook + SDR soundbites (Thu EOD), 4) michael -> vendor soundbites + product-legal friendly claim phrasing (Thu EOD). I'll compile Fri morning for the webinar narrative + slide deck. If no major edits by Thu EOD I'll lock claims. :thumbsup:

emily (sales): Thanks — I'll coordinate with SDR lead and add common buyer language.

michael (product): Quick note — avoid calling out specific cloud pricing line-items (they change). Use % ranges + concrete sample calc so we don't get into nitpicks.

ana (mktg): Perfect. If anyone wants to pair on the voice for the webinar narrative DM me.

(End of thread)
